Perks › Rare

Counterfeit Pip

Rare perk · Placement

Once per round, arm one blank as a wildcard, preview its wild placement, and spend the charge only when played.

In-game card text

How it works

Arm Counterfeit Pip, then one of your blank bones may be played on any open end as if its blank matched.

  • The double blank takes the end's value on both halves, so 0-0 played on a 4 becomes a 4-4 for the open ends and for scoring.
  • The charge is only spent by a play that would not have been legal anyway. If you make an ordinary play, the arming is cancelled and the charge is kept.
  • Each copy gives one use per hand. Wild Blank makes this permanent.

At a glance

RarityRare
TypePlacement
UsesOne use per hand for each copy you hold. Uses refill at the start of every hand.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 600 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Uncommon perks.
